question:
For the patients with an abnormal Ig M level, what is the most common disease they are diagnosed with?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: abnormal Ig M level refers to IGM <=40 OR IGM >= 400; most common disease refers to MAX(COUNT(Diagnosis));

prediction.sql:
SELECT p.XCL_064
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON l.XCL_014 = p.XCL_058
WHERE l.XCL_044 <= 40 OR l.XCL_044 >= 400
GROUP BY p.XCL_064
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;
